author: claude
summary: Wires mobile-width tool filtering into DirectorsConsole (task 007): at <=640px the console renders MobileModeSwitcher with a data-level filtered tool list instead of the desktop rail, so Cast/Revise/Write/placeholder tools are excluded from the DOM (not just CSS-hidden) per INV-MAP-4. Also redirects away from a desktop-only active tool if the viewport shrinks into mobile while one is active. Deviation flagged: the task described the mobile-eligible set as 'Booth + Book-view', but no 'book-view' tool id exists in directorsConsoleTools (Book View is the separate pages/Book/BookLayout.tsx page, not a console tool) -- so the mobile-eligible set implemented is Booth-only, with a code comment noting how to extend it once/if a book-view tool is registered.

files.change: Added useMediaQuery('(max-width: 640px)') + MOBILE_ELIGIBLE_TOOL_IDS (currently {'booth'}); conditional render of MobileModeSwitcher (mobile) vs the existing desktop rail (unchanged); added a useEffect that redirects activeToolId to the first mobile-eligible tool when the viewport is mobile and the active tool isn't mobile-eligible.

New test file (mocks useMediaQuery, CastTool, BoothTool) covering: mobile-only Booth rendering with Cast/Revise/Write/placeholders absent from the DOM, unchanged desktop rail, correct tablist container per breakpoint, auto-redirect off a desktop-only default tool at mobile width, and state preservation across a live desktop->mobile resize.
